entries.title: Isaiah 12:1
segments: And in that day you shall say, O LORD, I will praise You; though You were angry with me, turn away Your anger, and You shall comfort me.

entries.title: Isaiah 12:2
segments: Behold, God [is] my salvation; I will trust and not be afraid for the LORD JEHOVAH is my strength and my song; He also has become my salvation.

entries.title: Isaiah 12:3
segments: And with joy you shall draw water out of the wells of salvation.

entries.title: Isaiah 12:4
segments: And in that day you shall say, Praise the LORD! Call on His name; declare His doings among the people, make mention that His name is exalted.

entries.title: Isaiah 12:5
segments: Sing [to] the LORD; for He has done excellent things; this [is] known in all the earth.

entries.title: Isaiah 12:6
segments: Cry out and shout, O dweller of Zion; for great [is] the Holy One of Israel in your midst.
